metadata.description: Codex App plugins by Jacky Zhang. Includes FormBro (Canadian immigration form automation), EasyBooks (bookkeeping for self-employed Canadians), and future tools.

plugins.description: Canadian immigration form automation: read/write applications, persons, employers; drive webform fills; export PDFs/Excel — all via the bundled FormBro CLI.
plugins.name: formbro-cli

plugins.description: Bookkeeping for self-employed Canadians via the bundled EasyBooks CLI: drop a receipt, invoice, or scan Gmail and have it recorded into EasyBooks. The CLI is the only boundary for all EasyBooks reads and writes — record income/expenses, create and send invoices, and resolve clients/categories.
plugins.name: easybooks-cli

plugins.description: Query and export your own local chat archive (friends, groups, attachments, voice WAV) via the bundled AnyChat CLI. Free Portal token; content stays on your machine.
plugins.name: anychat-cli

plugins.description: Canadian Immigration Intelligence & Practical Tools Plugin powered by ImmiCore: Federal Court precedent legal ratios, official IRCC policy manuals & Help Centre Q&As, synthesized practitioner field insights, and statutory CLB benchmark calculators.
plugins.name: anyimmi-cli

plugins.description: Secure agent-native PDF form filling, one-shot intake, and Tell-Jacky feedback.
plugins.name: anypdf
